$note: 官祿宮（2026-10-12）：太陽.官祿。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 官祿宮 p.530–560。殉職、牢獄、官非、血光、貪墨、意外一類斷語不用；天刑、天月、天巫、龍池鳳閣、三台八座等引擎冇嘅星不用；天機見 tianji-guanlu.json（試點）。

rules.text: 太陽化祿，事業以名聲為主；經商的話，尤其要重視品牌商譽。
rules.en: Tai Yang in Abundance: your career runs on reputation; in business, look after your brand above all.

rules.text: 太陽化權，事業容易受外地或外國人提拔賞識；多學外語，對事業有幫助。
rules.en: Tai Yang in Authority: people from other places or countries tend to lift you up; learning their languages helps your career.

source.quote: 此为受异族提拔、赏识之星系

rules.text: 太陽化科，你宜做有榮譽感的專業工作。
rules.en: Tai Yang in Merit: work that carries honour, in a profession, suits you.

rules.text: 太陽化忌，宜做帶排難解紛或靠口才的工作，例如教學、演唱。
rules.en: Tai Yang in Hindrance: work that resolves disputes or relies on speaking suits you, such as teaching or performing.

source.quote: 所从事行业必须有排难解纷

rules.text: 太陽見左輔右弼，你工作上可以少些奔波勞碌。
rules.en: Tai Yang meets Zuo Fu or You Bi: your work involves less running around.

rules.text: 太陽主貴，在官祿宮很合適：順的話在行內有名聲，不順也有號召力。
rules.en: Tai Yang brings standing and sits well in the Career Palace: in good times you are known in your field, and even in bad times people follow you.
